grass.description: Click on grass tiles to place walls. Each grass tile in your penned area scores 1 point.
grass.ariaLabel: Grass tile at row {row}, column {col}. Click to build a wall.

water.description: Water tiles block movement and cannot be clicked. Walls cannot be placed on water.
water.ariaLabel: Water tile at row {row}, column {col}. Cannot be clicked.

wall.description: Walls block pet movement. Click on a wall to remove it. You have a limited number of walls to place.
wall.ariaLabel: Wall at row {row}, column {col}. Click to remove.

home.description: Your pet starts at the home tile. The penned area is measured from here.
home.ariaLabel: Home tile at row {row}, column {col}. Pet starting location.

star.description: Star tiles act like grass but score 3 points instead of 1 when inside your penned area.
star.ariaLabel: Star tile at row {row}, column {col}. Worth 3 points. Click to build a wall.

bee.description: Bee tiles act like grass but subtract 3 points when inside your penned area. Try to keep bees outside!
bee.ariaLabel: Bee tile at row {row}, column {col}. Costs 3 points. Click to build a wall.
